deliverables_manifest.zip_metadata: Fixed timestamps, sorted member paths, regular-file modes, DEFLATE level9. Byte reproducibility assumes fixed input files and compatible Python/zlib runtime.

publication_binding: This receipt precedes the distribution commit. FINAL_PUBLICATION_RECEIPT.json and DELIVERY_RECEIPT.json will bind the fetched distribution revision and exact delivered bytes.

verification_driver.packet_membership: Post-build verifier; outside the ZIP it verifies. The ZIP contains its own test suite and source-core inputs.

source_core_metadata_followup: Only RETAINED_TEST_IDENTITY_CHECK.json changed after the preceding source-core publication; its duplicated method suffixes and repair are preserved.
archive_is_fixed: Do not rebuild from a later delivery checkout and call it the same packet. Reproduction requires the recorded source-core inputs, generated handoff and exact publication receipt.
